items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, Jim Daddy Walker. He was the best guitar player around. He was a hell of a guitar player. He died. And then another boy called Cliff. A red, tall boy. He did some arranging. I think he did. He used to play with Georgia Lee. And they were the four guitar players I knew around there.

ctx.x: Yeah, Jim Daddy Walker. He was the best guitar player around. He was a hell of a guitar player. He died. And then another boy called Cliff. A red, tall boy. He did some arranging. I think he did. He used to play with Georgia Lee. And they were the four guitar players I knew around there.
Incidentally, the tune you're most famous for is "One O'Clock Jump."
